decision.justification: Selected 'median on pool4' (an agent proposal) as the best of 12 backtested attempts, score 0.7642. Series context: trend strength 0.4786 and seasonal strength 0.3875; model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.17); 4 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 2.496.
